description: This file defines abstract and concrete generic activator classes for creating instances of types, including support for reference and value types, using reflection and dynamic method generation.

classes.name: DefaultActivator<T>
classes.description: An abstract base class providing a mechanism to create instances of type T using reflection and dynamic method emission.

classes.name: DefaultReferenceTypeActivator<T>
classes.description: A sealed class for creating instances of reference types, utilizing a constructor or uninitialized object.

classes.name: DefaultValueTypeActivator<T>
classes.description: A sealed class for creating instances of value types, utilizing a constructor or uninitialized object.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes a delegate for creating instances of type T using a dynamic method.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Abstract method to create an instance of T, implemented in derived classes.
